ctx.x: Orson Welles, sure. Ginger Rogers. C.P. Johnson was real popular at the time, that played the Latin drums, and he was doing a lot of work in the movies out there, and he would bring a lot of people out. Do you remember C.P. Johnson, played the congas in some of those early movies from Warner Brothers.
A lot of famous people would come over to hear the Jazz, you know. Like, I remember a lot of the big-name musicians, who became big names later, used to be on the avenue every night, you know.
